subject: Request: Quarterly invoicing + Net-90 for Novatix annual contract
messages:
From: Paul O'Neill <p.oneill@novatix.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Novatix Procurement <procurement@novatix.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Billing cadence + payment terms for annual contract

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the thorough demo last week — team is excited. Procurement asked me to confirm whether Redwood can bill Novatix on a quarterly cadence for the annual license, and whether Net-90 terms are possible. Their fiscal calendar closes differently and they only process vendor payments on a quarterly schedule.

We are ready to issue the PO (attached) once terms are agreed. Key asks from our side:
- Quarterly invoicing (4 invoices over 12 months)
- Net-90 payment terms per invoice
- Standard SOW (we reviewed your v3 draft; see a couple of inline questions)

Can your team confirm whether Redwood can accommodate this? If there are tradeoffs (discount, deposit, ACH), please let me know so we can present internally.

Attachment: Novatix_PO_2026-11.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Paul
Paul O'Neill
Head of Procurement
Novatix Analytics

——
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Paul O'Neill <p.oneill@novatix.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Billing cadence + payment terms for annual contract

Paul —

Really appreciate the clarity. I’ve looped in Deal Desk (Laura) and Billing (Marissa) to confirm feasibility. High-level reply: we can consider quarterly invoices with Net-90 but need internal approvals and risk mitigations.

For the Deal Desk/Finance team: summary of the ask and suggested concessions for approval:
- Customer: Novatix Analytics (annual commitment $480k)
- Ask: 4 quarterly invoices, Net-90 payment terms per invoice
- Proposed concessions to reduce AR risk: 1) 25% initial deposit due on execution, 2) ACH mandate or corporate credit card on file, 3) 5% one-year introductory discount (conditional).

Attachments: Novatix_SOW_v3.pdf, payment_terms_proposal.xlsx (proposal shows cashflow under different options)

Can you confirm: which of these (deposit / ACH / discount) you can approve, and whether legal needs to add an amendment to the SOW?

Next steps: if we get a green light, I’ll send an amendment and a DocuSign for signatures and ask the customer to return the PO.

Thanks — Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189

——
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Billing cadence + payment terms for annual contract

Thanks for the summary, Soojin.

I reviewed the PO and SOW. A few notes from Deal Desk:
- Quarterly invoicing is operationally fine, but Net-90 materially increases DSO exposure versus our standard Net-30/Net-45.
- Discount requests (5% intro) need approval above my band — will require VP sign-off.
- If Finance requires a deposit or ACH mandate, we should document it in an amendment and tie the discount to deposit execution.

To Marissa: can you run a quick credit check and confirm AR risk appetite for Net-90 on a new customer of this size? Also confirm whether the 25% deposit + ACH mandate would be sufficient mitigation or if we need a broader payment guarantee.

I’ve tentatively marked this as an escalation for Aditya (cc’d) given size + non-standard terms.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Deal Desk
laura_bennett@redwood.com

——
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Billing cadence + payment terms for annual contract

Laura / Soojin —

I ran the credit checks and spoke with AR. Quick findings:
- Novatix is mid-market with decent banking history but slower vendor payment patterns (confirmed). No public adverse events.
- Allowing Net-90 across four invoices would increase projected DSO from ~42 days to ~95 days for this deal unless we secure upfront cash.

Conditional approval recommendation:
1) Approve quarterly invoicing with Net-90 only if the customer provides a 25% deposit at signing. That deposit will be applied to the first invoice.
2) Require ACH mandate OR an approved credit card on file for automatic collections; if ACH not possible, require a one-year credit hold and automated payment reminders.
3) Approve a temporary 3% introductory discount (not 5%) for year-one only, contingent on deposit + ACH.

Operational items: we will need an amendment to the SOW capturing the billing schedule, payment triggers, and payment method. I can draft the billing addendum; legal will need to review the language.

Attachment: payment_terms_proposal.xlsx (AR cashflow scenarios)

If Deal Desk and Sales accept these conditions, I will sign off and instruct Billing to create the quarterly invoice schedule in the system.

Marissa Cole
Manager, Revenue Operations
marissa_cole@redwood.com

——
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Billing cadence + payment terms for annual contract

Thanks team — I’ve reviewed the thread and Marissa’s assessment. Given the strategic nature of Novatix and the $480k ARR value, I’m comfortable approving the requested quarterly billing cadence with Net-90 under the following conditions:

1) 25% deposit due at execution (applies to first invoice)
2) ACH mandate OR corporate credit card on file for automated collections
3) Introductory discount capped at 3% for year one only (no recurring discount unless Performance/CS metrics justify)
4) Legal amendment documenting billing schedule and payment terms must be executed prior to activation

Soojin — please prepare the amendment and the DocuSign envelope. Laura / Marissa, once amendment is returned, confirm in HubSpot and set billing schedule.

Soojin, you can communicate the approved concessions to Paul and request the PO be reissued or confirm acceptance. If Novatix pushes for the 5% discount, escalate back to me with the business rationale.

Approved — Aditya
Aditya Rao
VP, Sales Operations
aditya_rao@redwood.com
